panel.title: Knowledge bases
panel.description: Create and manage knowledge bases your AI can search, then bind them to projects so workspace agents can use them.
panel.empty: No knowledge bases yet. Create one from a local directory, uploaded files, or a network dataset.

row.deleteConfirm: Delete knowledge base "{{name}}"? Its downloaded data and index will be removed too.

dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — a short note about what's in this knowledge base
dialog.localPathPlaceholder: Absolute path to the dataset (directory or file)
dialog.localPathHint: Agents can read the directory directly (read-only); a keyword index is also built for browsing and kb_search.
dialog.uploadHint: Supports .txt/.md and PDF/Word/Excel/PowerPoint. Files are parsed, chunked and indexed in the background.
dialog.urlPlaceholder: https://… direct link or archive (zip / tar.gz)
dialog.urlHint: On save the backend downloads and parses asynchronously; progress shows in the list. On failure you can retry or switch mirror.
dialog.urlMirrorHint: This preset ships {{count}} mirror(s); the primary is tried first, then each fallback in order.
dialog.editSourceNote: The source cannot be changed after creation.

bindings.title: Visibility (projects)
bindings.hint: Once bound to a project, agents in that project's workspaces can search and direct-read this knowledge base. Unbound = invisible to every agent.
bindings.empty: Not bound to any project yet.

browser.title: Browse knowledge base
browser.searchPlaceholder: Search this knowledge base by keyword…
browser.documentsEmpty: This knowledge base has no documents to browse yet.
browser.resultsHint: Enter a keyword to start searching.
browser.notReady: The knowledge base isn't ready yet — browse and search once indexing completes.

project.title: Knowledge bases
project.description: Bind existing knowledge bases to this project so its workspace agents can search and direct-read them.
project.empty: No knowledge bases bound to this project yet.
project.removeConfirm: Remove knowledge base "{{name}}" from this project?
project.configureFirst: You don't have any knowledge bases yet. Create one in Settings → Integrations first.
project.pick: Select a knowledge base to bind…

workspaceMount.title: Mounted knowledge bases
workspaceMount.description: Mount knowledge bases to this workspace. Each mounted KB is copied read-only into <datasets/<name>/> inside the workspace file tree and auto-ingested, so the agent can browse and search it directly.
workspaceMount.pick: Select a knowledge base to mount…
workspaceMount.none: No knowledge bases mounted to this workspace yet.
workspaceMount.noKbs: No knowledge bases available. Create one in Settings → Integrations first.
workspaceMount.unmountConfirm: Unmount knowledge base "{{name}}" from this workspace? Its read-only copy in the file tree is removed; the source knowledge base is untouched.
